notes: The descriptor «مولى» (freedman of) stays in the surface as part of how the man is written; the patron named in it is not a link
«أم هانئ ابنة أبي طالب» occurs twice; the second is the Companion who speaks (her own words), the first is in Abu Murra's description

«مولى عمر بن عبيد الله» and «مولى أم هانئ» are descriptions of the men, not part of their names; «أن أبا مرة … أخبره» and «سمع أم هانئ» are links by rule 5; the first occurrence of «أم هانئ ابنة أبي طالب» is in the description, so the second is the link
